summary: Admin UI: surface guest queries from the queries table — ip-name, in/out, spend; guest bucket in overview
description: Depends on guest rows existing in queries. Give admin visibility on guests (incl. non-converted = user_id IS NULL, tier_used='guest'): (1) a Guests list + detail under (admin)/admin/guests reading queries WHERE tier_used='guest' with ip_name, guest_ip, query_text/response_text (in/out), model, cost_usd, created_at, and a converted-vs-not filter (converted = the row later got a user_id). Reuse the admin/queries/[id] detail shape. (2) In src/lib/admin-queries.ts + /api/admin/overview add a guest spend bucket alongside pro/free (SUM(cost_usd) WHERE tier_used='guest') in fetchOverviewStats + fetchDailySeries, and guest query counts. (3) Decide the bare COUNT(*) FROM queries (queries_today/week/month) — either keep authed-only (add WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL) or split guest out explicitly; do NOT let guests silently inflate authed counts. Note the existing admin queries detail JOIN users stays INNER (guests live on their own page). Tests for the new aggregates.
